summary: Muuqaalka buuxa ee Motion Graphic-ga ah ee sharxaya dhammaan qaybaha App-ka Tuko. Wuxuu leeyahay qalab toos ah oo video-ga loogu duubo loona soo degsado (Export HD Video / MP4 / WebM), codadka sharraxaadda, daawasho toos ah (9:16 Reels iyo 16:9 Widescreen), iyo animation-no heer sare ah. Waxaad toos uga furan kartaa taleefan ama computer kasta adigoo hal gujis ku soo degsanaya faylka video-ga.
